request: In a multithreaded tree scan, report a folder itself only as a failure if access controls prevent listing its children, so consumers never see a usable item they cannot explore.

source.request: In a multithreaded tree scan, report a folder itself only as a failure if access controls prevent listing its children, so consumers never see a usable item they cannot explore.
source.settled: The parallel walker yields a successful directory entry before reporting failure to descend into an unreadable directory, matching the serial walker.
source.why: Replacing the successful item with a failure restores the parallel-walk inconsistency the ticket fixed.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
